questions_and_answers.question_text: What is the literal meaning of láodònglì?
What else may láodònglì refer to?
Which pattern means "to be good for..."?
Write the Chinese for "In rural areas, women are a very important source of labor."

answers.answer_text: Fùnǚ zài nóngcūn shi xiāngdāng zhòngyàode láodònglì.

questions_and_answers.question_text: What might "four and a half" able-bodied persons mean?

answers.answer_text: The half may be a child or an older person who cannot do as much work.
Any three of: nénglì (ability), diànlì (electric power), rénlì (manpower), tīnglì (hearing ability), huǒlì (firepower), shuǐlì (water power), dònglì (driving force).

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "He was very rude to me, so I won't talk with him anymore."

answers.answer_text: Tā duì wǒ hěn bú kèqi, wǒ yě jiu bù gēn ta shuō huà le.

articles.text:
4. A: Jiāli láodònglì duō, shēnghuó  If a family has more manpower, then it
      yě jiu huì hǎo yìdiǎnr.        follows that life will be a little
                                      better.
   B: Kěshi xiànzài rénkǒu duō bù   But now it's not necessarily an
      yídìng yǒu shénme hǎochu.      advantage to have a lot of people.

Notes on No. 4

láodònglì: "work force," literally "labor-power."

Fùnǚ zài nóngcūn shi xiāngdāng   In rural areas, women are a very
zhòngyàode láodònglì.            important source of labor.

Láodònglì may also be used to refer to ABLE-BODIED INDIVIDUALS who do manual labor:

A: Tāmen jiā yǒu jǐge láodònglì? How many able-bodied persons are there
                                 in their family?
B: Yǒu sìge bàn láodònglì.       There are four and a half. (The half
                                 may be a child or an older person who
                                 cannot do as much work.)

-lì by itself means "power" or "ability," and is used in combinations:

nénglì     ability          rénlì      manpower
diànlì     electric power   tīnglì     hearing ability
huǒlì      firepower        shuǐlì     water power, hydraulic power
dònglì     motivating power, driving force

yě jiu: "accordingly," literally "also then." Other translations are "correspondingly," "so." The tone of jiu is often neutral.

Tā duì wǒ hěn bú kèqi, wǒ yě     He was very rude to me, so I won't
jiu bù gēn ta shuō huà le.       talk with him anymore.
Wǒ xiǎng qù, kěshi méi biérén    I wanted to go, but nobody else did,
yào qù, yě jiu suàn le.          so I said the heck with it.

hǎochu: "benefit, advantage." The phrase yǒu hǎochu means "to be advantageous, to be beneficial."

Use the pattern DUÌ...YǑU HǍOCHU for "to be good for..., to be of benefit to...":

Yǒu rén shuō hē píjiǔ duì        Some people say that it is good for
shēntǐ yǒu hǎochu.               the health to drink beer.
Wǒmen yíkuàir niàn shū duì       It would be advantageous to both of us
liǎngge rén dōu yǒu hǎochu.      to study together.
